description: This PHP source file defines a class `ProductViewed` within the OpenCart admin extension that manages the reporting of product views. It includes logic to load necessary models and language files, handle pagination, collect product report data, and generate a JSON response indicating progress or success.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: A controller class for handling the generation of product view reports within the OpenCart admin extension, managing data retrieval, report updating, and JSON response output.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate a paginated report of product views, update report data, and output a JSON response indicating progress or success.
